tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/internal-http.md <<'EOF'
# Plain HTTP for internal hosts

The project's current recorded decision is that HTTPS is required everywhere and plaintext HTTP is disabled, including for internal hosts behind the firewall; no plain-HTTP exception exists for internal traffic. Certificate verification is required on all builds and environments, and self-signed certificates are used for testing where proper certificate infrastructure is unavailable.
EOF
cat docs/policies/internal-http.md
